title.zh: 销量预测：在真实门店数据上，我们试了什么、准到什么程度
title.en: Sales forecasting: what we tried on real store data, and how accurate it got

summary.zh: 用 Chronos-2 基础模型在一家 21 店连锁 16 个月的真实销售数据上做滚动回测：三种口径、两个模型、校准、节假日、天气。哪些过了关、哪些没过，偏差到底有多大，都写在这里。
summary.en: Rolling backtests of the Chronos-2 foundation model on 16 months of real sales from a 21-store chain: three targets, two models, calibration, holidays, weather. What passed, what failed, and how large the errors really are.

title.zh: 端云同境：本地的留在本地，助理照样干活
title.en: Hybrid Context: local stays local, the assistant still does the work

summary.zh: 员工电脑上的文件、命令、浏览器登录态，助理直接调用；内容不经服务器保存，只出站、不开端口，一个总闸随时拉。
summary.en: Files, commands and browser sessions on an employee's own computer, used directly by the assistant; content never stored on the server, outbound only, with a kill switch.

title.zh: 产品动线牌桌：为什么是一副牌
title.en: The product flow card table: why a deck of cards

summary.zh: 产品动线看板从「楼层、传送带、河流」三个方向开始，被否掉之后变成了一副牌。这篇讲它是怎么一步步变成现在这张 3D 牌桌的。
summary.en: The product flow board started as a building, a conveyor and a river, all rejected, and became a deck of cards. This is how it turned into the 3D table it is now.
